summary.headline: Profits shrinking and revenue flat, but cash flow remains solid
summary.takeaway: Tesla's sales have stalled and profit has fallen since FY2023, with EPS (profit per share) down 43.6% from a year ago. Cash flow is still stronger than reported profit, and cash is well above debt.

positives.text: Operating cash flow was $6.26 billion in Q3 FY26, far above net income of $0.787 billion. Cash conversion (cash compared with profit) is 5.81x.
Cash of $17.9 billion in Q3 FY26 is well above total debt of $9.27 billion.
Gross margin (sales left after production costs) was 19.6% in Q3 FY26, up from 18% a year earlier.

watch_outs.text: Yearly net income fell from $15 billion in FY2023 to $3.79 billion in FY2025. Net margin (profit share of sales) dropped from 15.5% to 4%.
Operating margin (profit from main business) was 2.56% in Q3 FY26, down from 5.78% a year earlier. Revenue was flat, down 0.2%.
Capital spending jumped to $5.79 billion in Q2 FY26, pushing free cash flow (cash left after investment) to minus $1.09 billion.

what_to_watch_next: Whether capital spending stays near the Q3 FY26 level of $4.73 billion and free cash flow stays positive.
